item.title: Alabama Fire College 2026 Fire Explorer Weekend
item.description: Seven of our Helena Fire Department Cadets traveled to the Alabama Fire College for the 2026 Fire Explorer Weekend. They joined 113 youth, 46 Advisors, and 50 Volunteer Staff from across Alabama and Georgia for a weekend of hands-on training. item.title: Montgomery Co. Academy Graduates 42
item.description: The last graduating class of the Montgomery County Fire Academy, Class 2504, graduated 42 new firefighters from Firefighter I on January 7, 2026. This brought the total number of firefighter graduates for 2025 to 137. Congratulations and best of luck to all the new firefighters! – Fire News photos by Regina Jelski

item.title: Greenawalds Chief Andrew Garger and Lower Macungie Captain Joshua Houck
item.description: Greenawalds Chief Andrew Garger and Lower Macungie Captain Joshua Houck pose for a quick photo at a structure fire in Upper Macungie Twp. on January 7, 2026. – Fire News photo by Geoffrey Wetherhold

item.title: 3-Vehicle MVA Rollover with Entrapment
item.description: On January 6, 2026, Station 69 (Lower Burrell) and 56 (New Kensington) were called to a three-vehicle accident, with one vehicle rolled over with an entrapment. Crews quickly cut the roof from a rolled over vehicle to free the driver, who was transported to a local hospital. – Fire News photo by Steve Matto

item.description: Just before 0800 hours on December 24, 2026, Lower Burrell crews and surrounding stations were called to a basement fire in Lower Burrell.
